name: Muscle Biology & Physiology
summary: How muscles generate force, from the molecular motor to the whole muscle, and how nerves control them: the biology an exoskeleton must work with.

topics.name: Skeletal muscle structure: fibres, myofibrils and the sarcomere
Sliding filament theory and the cross-bridge cycle
Motor units, recruitment (Henneman's size principle) and rate coding
Electromyography (EMG): origin of the signal and what it measures
Muscle fatigue: central and peripheral mechanisms
Muscle plasticity: hypertrophy, atrophy and disuse
Muscle repair, satellite cells and regeneration
Neuromuscular diseases (muscular dystrophies, ALS, myasthenia gravis)
